source_text: Circumcisio signum foederis in carne; intellectus: amputatio vitiorum. Non sola cutis — cor circumcidendum. Paulus: circumcisio cordis in spiritu, non littera.
pass_a_gloss: Circumcision sign of-covenant in flesh; understanding: cutting-off of-vices. Not only skin — heart to-be-circumcised. Paul: circumcision of-heart in spirit, not letter.
pass_b_english: Circumcision is the covenant’s sign in the flesh; its meaning is the cutting away of vices. Not skin alone — the heart must be circumcised. Paul: [[circumcision of the heart in the Spirit, not the letter >> Bible:Romans 2:29]].
